name: VERIFICATION_RUN_008
description: Genuine cold-machine verification walk for the O6 open problem: fresh container, no pre-existing .lake/packages or ~/.cache/mathlib, lake exe cache get performing a real network fetch (not a local cache decompression as in RUN_007)
author: Claude Sonnet 5 (Claude Code session), continuing a concurrent cold-machine attempt reported by another agent on the same repo
o6_status: Further narrowed, not closed: this run demonstrates the prebuilt-cache endpoint completing a genuine 8678/8678-file network fetch from a truly cold machine and the full 32-target gate passing on top of it. It does not establish that the endpoint is reliably cold-fetchable -- a concurrent attempt on a different machine hit a stall on the same endpoint around the same time and fell back to source compilation. O6 remains open in the sense of 'not guaranteed'; a CI runner exercising this path on every push, per RUN_007's stated remaining gap, is still not in place.
